grammar.title: No matter what with 不论...都
grammar.pattern: 不论 + 疑问词/选择，(主语) + 都 + 结果
grammar.explanation: 不论 (bùlùn) means "no matter, regardless of" — often followed by a question word like 谁/什么/怎么 or an either-or choice, with 都 in the result clause. It shows the outcome stays the same in every case.

grammar.title: It's said that with 据说
grammar.explanation: 据说 (jùshuō) means "it's said that, reportedly" — used to share information you heard from others, without confirming it yourself. It starts the sentence.

sentences.pinyin: Bùlùn duō máng, tā dōu huì yùndòng.
sentences.en: No matter how busy he is, he always exercises.

sentences.pinyin: Bùlùn shéi wèn, wǒ dōu bù huì shuō.
sentences.en: No matter who asks, I won't say.

sentences.zh: 不论去哪里，他都带着这本书。
sentences.pinyin: Bùlùn qù nǎlǐ, tā dōu dàizhe zhè běn shū.
sentences.en: No matter where he goes, he always brings this book.

sentences.zh: 据说这家饭店的菜很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō zhè jiā fàndiàn de cài hěn hǎochī.
sentences.en: It's said that the food at this restaurant is delicious.

sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō tā míngnián yào jiéhūn le.
sentences.en: It's said that he's getting married next year.

sentences.pinyin: Jùshuō nà bù diànyǐng hěn jīngcǎi.
sentences.en: It's said that movie is very exciting.
